class.name: BehaviorRepeat
class.brief_description: Runs its child again each time it finishes.
class.description: Runs its first child again each time it finishes, once a tick at most, [member times] times or for ever.

members.member: If on, a child that fails is run again like one that succeeded. If off, the repeat fails with it.
How many times to run the child before succeeding. [code]0[/code] repeats for ever.
